verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents programmatic creation of connected accounts for businesses and individuals, which covers seller onboarding, and Transfers for paying out funds to third parties. Nothing in the evidence shows splitting a single payment between platform and sellers, or payouts tied to connected-account balances. The sandbox also explicitly excludes Connected Account APIs, which limits testing of a platform integration. missing for 10: documented payment-splitting / platform-fee mechanics, explicit per-seller payout flow tied to connected accounts, sandbox support for Connected Account APIs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
